extracted.intended_audience: patent researchers, historians, librarians, patent practitioners
extracted.subtask_description: An alphabetized index of patentees/patent entries for patents issued in 1877, showing each patentee's name, residence, invention title, grant date, monthly report volume, Official Gazette reference, and patent number; used for lookup and bibliographic reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alphabetical ordering of patentees
rubrics_metrics.description: Patentees are listed in alphabetical order (by surname) across the index.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries are grouped and sequenced alphabetically to facilitate lookup; headings show the current alphabetical range (e.g., 'Alphabetical list of patentees for the year 1877—Continued').

rubrics_metrics.name: Entry fields: name, residence, and invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Each index entry provides the patentee's name, place of residence, and a short title or description of the invention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Invention descriptions are concise (e.g., 'Car-starter', 'Refrigerator'); assignor information is often parenthesized (e.g., 'assignor to ...'). Use of initials, punctuation, and variants (jr., sr., et al.) follows the original record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bibliographic/reference fields: date, monthly volume, Official Gazette
rubrics_metrics.description: Each entry records the patent grant date plus references to the monthly volume and Official Gazette number associated with the patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Date formats vary but indicate grant date; the monthly volume and Official Gazette columns provide cross-reference citations for locating the full patent text and publication notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent number / No. column
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries include a patent or index number (No.) used to identify the issued patent within the year's register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numbers appear in a dedicated column and are essential for precise lookup; they may be grouped in pages showing many entries per page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-references for assignments and related entries
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries frequently include cross-references such as '(See ... assignor.)', '(Reissue.)', or parenthetical notes indicating assignments, reissues, or related patentees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cross-references show legal relationships (assignments, reissues) and direct the reader to related index entries; they are part of the bibliographic metadata and should be preserved when extracting records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concise invention-title style
rubrics_metrics.description: Invention descriptions are brief, noun-phrase titles (e.g., 'Steam-boiler and superheater', 'Washing-machine', 'Gate-latch').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Titles prioritize brevity and a functional noun/phrase; longer explanations are given only in parentheses when indicating assignors or special status (e.g., 'Reissue'). When digitizing, preserve the concise title as the primary description field.
